story.iWant: to backup selected partitions with progress feedback
story.soThat: I can save my device data
story.tasks:
- Task 1: Create BackupConfirmDialog component (AC: 2) - Create src/components/features/backup/BackupConfirmDialog.tsx - Use shadcn/ui Dialog component - Display list of selected partitions with names and sizes - Show total backup size calculation - Add "Choose Location" and "Cancel" buttons - Integrate with usePartitionStore to get selected partitions - Style with Linear Violet theme
- Task 2: Create BackupProgress component (AC: 4, 5, 10) - Create src/components/features/backup/BackupProgress.tsx - Use shadcn/ui Progress component for overall progress bar - Display current partition being backed up - Show bytes written / total bytes with formatBytes utility - Display percentage (0-100%) - Show partition-by-partition status list with icons (Clock, Loader, CheckCircle, XCircle) - Add "Cancel Backup" button - Read progress from flashStore
- Task 3: Enhance flashStore for backup operations (AC: 4, 5, 9, 10) - Add backup-specific state to src/stores/flashStore.ts - Add backup actions (startBackup, updateBackupProgress, setBackupPartitionStatus, completeBackup, cancelBackup, resetBackup) - Ensure state updates trigger re-renders
- Task 4: Create useBackup hook (AC: 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9) - Create src/hooks/useBackup.ts - Wrap FirehoseProtocol read operations (DO NOT modify core logic) - Implement startBackup method with File System Access API integration - Implement cancelBackup method with graceful cleanup - Log all operations to terminalStore - Handle errors gracefully - Use useRef for cancellation flag and protocol instance
- Task 5: Implement File System Access API integration (AC: 3, 7, 8) - Add showDirectoryPicker() call in BackupConfirmDialog - Request write permission for selected directory - Create partition backup files (.img) - Generate rawprogram_backup.xml with partition metadata - Handle permission errors
- Task 6: Integrate backup flow into PartitionGrid (AC: 1, 2) - Add "Backup Selected" button to PartitionGrid header - Button is disabled when no partitions selected - Button shows count - Clicking button opens BackupConfirmDialog - Pass selected partitions from partitionStore to dialog
- Task 7: Add barrel exports (AC: all) - Create src/components/features/backup/index.ts - Export BackupConfirmDialog and BackupProgress - Update src/hooks/index.ts to export useBackup
- Task 8: Add i18n translations (AC: all) - Add English translations to src/i18n/translations/en.json - Add Vietnamese translations to src/i18n/translations/vi.json
- Task 9: Testing and verification (AC: 1-10) - Run npm run dev and verify no TypeScript errors - Test backup flow with device connected - Test directory picker - Test backup progress - Test backup completion - Test backup cancellation - Test error handling - Test with large partitions - Test i18n - Test state persistence

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC1: When partitions are selected, a "Backup" button is enabled AC2: Clicking "Backup" opens a confirmation dialog showing selected partitions AC3: User can choose save location using File System Access API AC4: Backup progress shows: current partition, bytes/total, percentage AC5: Each partition status updates: pending → in-progress → done AC6: Errors during backup are logged to terminal and shown to user AC7: Success toast shows with backup location after completion AC8: XML metadata file is created for restore compatibility AC9: Backup can be cancelled mid-operation AC10: Progress persists across component re-renders

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: User story defining backup flow with progress feedback, including confirmation dialog, directory selection, progress tracking, error handling, and metadata generation for restore compatibility.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: Pattern for wrapping core Firehose/WebUSB logic in React hooks without modifying core files. Uses useRef for singleton instances, useCallback for memoized methods, and cleanup on unmount.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: State machine pattern for flash/backup operations with states: idle, preparing, connecting, authenticating, flashing/backing-up, completing, success, error. Includes progress tracking with current partition, bytes written, total bytes.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: Files >1GB: Stream without full memory load. Progress updates: Every 1% or 1MB. Chunk size: 1MB for optimal performance. Retry logic: 3 attempts per chunk.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: Core Firehose/WebUSB logic is NEVER modified, only wrapped. Logic is tested and working, risk of regression too high. Implementation: Use ref-based hooks to wrap class instances.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: All feature components follow structure: 1) Hooks at top, 2) Derived state, 3) Handlers, 4) Render. Use cn() utility, useTranslation for i18n, and store hooks for state management.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: All stores follow structure with state, actions, and optional persist middleware. Use create() from zustand, define TypeScript interfaces, and implement actions with set/get.

story-context.constraints: - CRITICAL: DO NOT modify any files in src/core/, src/auth/, src/services/ (ADR-002: Preserve Core Logic) - Use Hook Wrapper Pattern: Wrap FirehoseProtocol.readPartition() in useBackup hook without modifying core logic - Follow Component Pattern: Hooks at top, derived state, handlers, render - Follow Zustand Store Pattern: Define state interface, use create(), implement actions with set/get - Use File System Access API for directory selection and file writing (Chrome/Edge 86+ only) - Stream data in 1MB chunks to avoid memory issues with large partitions (>1GB) - Update progress every 1% or 1MB to prevent excessive re-renders - Use useRef for cancellation flag to enable graceful cancellation - Close all writable streams properly to prevent memory leaks - Log all operations to terminalStore with appropriate log levels (info, success, warning, error) - Show toast notifications for user feedback (success, error, cancelled) - Generate rawprogram_backup.xml metadata file for restore compatibility - Follow i18n pattern: backup.{subcategory}.{key} naming convention - Style with Linear Violet theme colors from globals.css - Ensure TypeScript type safety for all components and hooks - Handle errors gracefully: catch read errors, catch file write errors, continue with next partition or stop based on severity - Support cancellation mid-operation with proper cleanup - Persist progress state across component re-renders using flashStore

tests.standards: Testing standards for Q-Flash-Web follow Vitest + React Testing Library pattern. Component tests should verify rendering, user interactions, and state updates. Hook tests should verify state management and side effects. Integration tests should verify full backup flow with mocked File System Access API and FirehoseProtocol. All tests should be placed in __tests__ directories adjacent to source files or in tests/ directory at project root.
